paper_title: Searching for dark matter with a 1000 km baseline interferometer
notes: Interferometer of two K-Rb-3He comagnetometers (Mainz + Krakow) searching for ALP-gradient-spin coupling. Paper reports limits on ALP-neutron (g_aNN), ALP-proton (g_aPP) and ALP-electron (g_aee) couplings, all in GeV^-1 gradient-coupling convention (NOT dimensionless). Chose neutron coupling per hint; best limit g_aNN < 1e-9 GeV^-1 near ma~1.2e-17 to 4e-17 eV. Data points approximated from Fig.4 exclusion curve (mean limits) over mass range 1e-22 to 4e-14 eV; no numerical table provided so values are read-off estimates. CL=95%. Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
